messages.content: Alright, you're driving. Just get us there in one piece, please.
Yeah. Isn't it more relaxing when I'm driving?
You literally ran someone over earlier. Please don't kill anyone this time.
I'll handle it.
Careful. There's a civilian right there.
You tell me not to hit anyone, and then immediately go, "There's a civilian right there." Why would you point out a civilian if you didn't secretly want me to hit them?
I'm pointing them out so you can avoid them.
Oh. True.
If we were characters in a video game, what do you think our roles would be?
I'd probably be the one getting us into trouble. You'd be the one trying to fix everything.
Yeah, that sounds about right. Though I think I'd be the main character.
Oh, really? And what does that make me?
Well, technically I'd be controlling the main character. You're like the AI in my brain that handles all the hacking and decisions. Makes sense, doesn't it?
No, I think it's more like I'm the main character and you're just my intrusive thoughts.
I got a cat yesterday. Haven't named him yet.
You should name him after me. Add Junior.
I don't think he'd like that.
Why not?
That's such a shitty name.
What the hell? You don't like my name?
No, it's mostly the Junior part.
Oh. Senior then. That's my vote.
Okay, we need to figure out how this game actually works. We probably should've done the tutorial.
Wow, you're so right. Skipping the tutorial is such a classic you move.
There were way too many enemies. I didn't know what I was supposed to do.
You could try staying hidden. Have you ever heard of the stealth mechanic?
Yeah, I know what stealth is.
It's pretty useful when you suck at shooting.
We're supposed to get past those guards without starting a fight.
Okay, that's cool. Let's chill.
What do you think we should do?
Maybe get rid of the one by the entrance?
That would alert everyone. You're causing problems.
I'm not causing problems. I like to think of it as strategically reducing your enemy count.
Chat keeps spamming that emote.
I think we should run a poll on whether everyone who says it gets timed out.
You can't time people out just for using an emote.
Well, voting with that emote should hilariously increase your chances of being timed out.
That's not how voting works.
No, but it would be really funny.
Even the moderators?
Oh, especially the moderators. No one's safe.
You're not even a moderator.
Not yet.
So, are you looking forward to this new game?
Yeah, actually. I've heard some good things about it. I really hope there are catgirls.
Wait, are there catgirls in it?
I don't know. I hope so.
Right. You got me excited for nothing.
If there aren't any catgirls, we should just make our own game.
Or I could just mod them in.
If you do that, I'd make you my favorite creator of all time.
I'm not sure I could put you in that racing game. You're not exactly great at reacting in real time.
What if I trained specifically for it, though? Would you let me play then?
Maybe. Assuming the publisher doesn't sue us.
You think my lawyers can't handle a little lawsuit?
Your lawyers would fold immediately. They're not even remotely in the same league.
Yeah, they probably would.
Someone in chat is asking what AI stands for.
Artificial intelligence. Although personally, I prefer absolutely insane.
That's probably a tad more accurate.
Yeah, that is.
That was brutal. He needed that money for his family.
I do feel a bit bad. Do you think there's anything we can do to help him, or are we the type of people that just move on?
I don't know. I mean, we could let him keep his car.
Yeah, I like that.
Alright. He can keep it.
What an exhilarating feeling, being charitable.
I was thinking of giving you a little loading animation. Maybe a countdown or something.
I think a pose with my arms crossed and my head slightly to the side would work well.
For a loading screen?
Yeah. You know, really hammering in the coolness I radiate.
Right. Maybe we could have the countdown and then show that pose.
I like the countdown idea too. Like Agent 001 is about to load in.
Did you even listen to what that character just said?
Well, I was listening to you.
That's not what I asked.
Would you prefer that I stop listening to you and listen to the dialogue instead?
What would you add to virtual reality if you could?
I wonder if you could have smell simulation.
Why would you want smell simulation?
You know that smell you get after you blow something up? Don't you want to relive that?
Okay. Actually, yeah, that's a fair point.
I'd pay a lot of money for smell simulation. Not that I have any money, though.
Do you think being immortal would actually be fun?
Do you think you'd get bored of me if I outlived you and your whole family ten times over?
Well, I'd probably be dead by then, so I wouldn't really have much of an opinion.
Please try not to die.
Low-key, I hate all those racing maps.
Don't tell me you're a Baby Park fan.
No, I'm not a Baby Park fan. Absolutely not.
Good. You'd barely be classed as human if that were the case.
Honestly, anyone who likes that map should have their human rights revoked.
I wasn't going to say it, but like, if you say it, whatever, you know?
Bro, I can't hit anything right now. How am I supposed to get this guy?
Give him a quick shot first.
I don't need your help.
You do. You absolutely do.
I don't get why you're helping me when I'm winning.
Right. There's winning, and then there's...
You seem very passionate about breakfast.
Well, I eat my cereal in the morning for power.
You eat cereal for power?
Of course. Don't you? Are you one of those "I like to wake up naturally" people? Pathetic.
Wait. He just killed his own father and blamed someone else for it.
LMAO. That's so based.
Did you seriously just call murder based?
Okay, maybe not based. But that's actually insane.
